sentences.en: I hired a personal trainer to help me lose weight.
sentences.zh: 我请了一个私人教练帮我减肥。

sentences.en: The gym offers sessions with personal trainers for beginners.
sentences.zh: 健身房为初学者提供私人教练的课程。

sentences.en: She decided to become a personal trainer after graduating from college.
sentences.zh: 她毕业后决定成为一名私人教练。
